title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Extension Charge
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — extension charge**

An extension charge applies to the Hometown Heroes award, worked out differently by the days the credit's validity has been extended beyond the program's validity days, counted from the reserved date to the current expiration date: the calendar days from the credit's reservation date to its current expiration date, less the program's validity days, never below zero. The charge is subtracted from the award, before the award is raised to 500.00 when below it and lowered to the program's credit cap when above it.

| Extended days | Method | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| more than 45 | 25.00 plus 0.50 for each extended day beyond 45 | rises with the days |
| 1 to 45 | flat charge, whatever the number of days | 25.00 |
| none | no charge | 0.00 |

**Clause.** More than 45 extended days are charged 25.00 plus 0.50 for each extended day beyond 45; 1 to 45 extended days are charged a flat 25.00; no extended days carry no charge.

### Worked figures (hypothetical credit reserved on 1 March 2026, program validity of 90 days)

| Current expiration date | Days from the reservation date | Extended days | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 May 2026 | 90 | 0 | 0.00 |
| 29 June 2026 | 120 | 30 | 25.00 |
| 14 July 2026 | 135 | 45 | 25.00 |
| 15 July 2026 | 136 | 46 | 25.50 |
| 29 July 2026 | 150 | 60 | 32.50 |
